$comment: Shared VfPanel cases. Plain data only. The vocabulary is the historical Vue contract at fd793696f50d3be0fcd3788f0f8f751c63869963. This catalog is not derived from contracts/card/cases.json and must never be replaced by cases that are: VfCard is the nearest structural neighbour this component has, and a Card-shaped implementation of VfPanel passes every case that does not name a difference. The cases that name one are panel/content-empty (a panel emits nothing where a card emits an empty classed div), panel/ignored-footer-slot (a panel has no footer at all), panel/content-only and panel/multiple-root-nodes (the default slot renders straight into the section with no wrapper), and panel/subtle-* (a modifier that repaints rather than tightens). Cases whose slot content is interactive declare consumerInteractive: the number of focusable controls the *consumer* put in the panel. The static snapshot is asserted against that number rather than against zero, so a control the component itself grew still fails even when every target grows it identically.

propVocabulary.title: string, default undefined. Opens the header and fills the fallback heading. Tested for truthiness, so an empty string opens nothing.
propVocabulary.subtle: boolean, default false. Repaints the background and removes the shadow. It is not VfCard's compact, which tightens padding and column gap instead.

slotVocabulary.header: Replaces the fallback h3 when it renders content. A header slot that renders nothing still opens the wrapper and brings the heading back.
slotVocabulary.body: The default slot. It renders straight into the section: no wrapper, no condition, nothing emitted when it renders nothing.
slotVocabulary.footer: Not a panel slot. Declared by one case so that 'a panel renders no footer' is measured rather than assumed; the component ignores it exactly as it ignores any undeclared slot.
